A tiny pet that lives in a little house at the bottom-left of your screen and trots after your cursor. Pick a curly Morkie (Snowy), a panda (Bao) or a teddy bear (Honey).

Not on a Mac? [Try it in your browser](https://vijaykadapala07.github.io/cursor-puppy/).

## Install on an Apple Silicon Mac
1. Download **CursorPuppy-1.3.0-mac-apple-silicon.zip** below.
2. Double-click the zip, then drag **Cursor Puppy.app** into **Applications**.
3. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first launch needs one extra step:
   right-click the app > **Open** > **Open**. On macOS 15 or newer, if that only offers "Done", open
   **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
   (Terminal alternative: `xattr -cr "/Applications/Cursor Puppy.app"`, then open it normally.)
4. Your pet pops out of its house and starts following the cursor.

## What's in 1.3.0
- Your pet follows the cursor onto every screen: it walks off the edge and appears on the next monitor.
- Click the house or the paw in the menu bar to call it, play ball, tie it at home, send it to bed, switch pet or rename it.
- Leave the mouse still and it naps right where it is.

Intel Macs aren't built yet; this download is for Apple Silicon (M1 and newer).
